## Test Case Description

Describe the new test case or improvement to an existing test.

## Purpose

Explain why this test is necessary (e.g., to cover a specific feature, edge case, or bug fix).

## Steps

1. Describe the steps or scenario to be tested.
2. Include expected inputs and outputs.

## Current Coverage

Explain the current test coverage and what gaps this test addresses.

## Additional Context

Provide any other relevant information, such as links to issues, PRs, or related documentation.
